title: Reduced C*-algebras of the Thompson family: an attributed consequence of nonamenability

original_abstract_tex: Combining OpenAI's announced nonamenability theorem for the standard Thompson group $F$ with the published equivalences of Le Boudec and Matte Bon gives simplicity of the reduced group C*-algebras of $F$, $T$, $\Aut(F)$ and the abstract commensurator $\Comm(F)$. Their canonical traces are their unique tracial states by the discrete-group trace theorem of Breuillard, Kalantar, Kennedy and Ozawa. We record the exact hypotheses, countability and attribution, and the corresponding consequence for countable circle-homeomorphism overgroups of the standard action. The argument is an application of established reductions, not a new simplicity criterion or an independent proof of nonamenability. Unique trace for $T$ was already known unconditionally. All conclusions involving the new input have exactly the same dependency on its validity.
